## Available Research Datasets

The following datasets from my published research are available for
academic use. Please cite the original papers when using these data.

| Paper | Dataset | Description |
|------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------|
| @dertwinkel-kaltConcentrationBiasIntertemporal2021 | @dertwinkel-kaltReplicationPackageConcentration2021 | Laboratory experiment data on concentration bias in intertemporal choice, including decision tasks and demographic data |
| @lambarraaNormsCharitableGiving2015 | @rienerReplicationDataFatima2022 | Field experiment data from Morocco examining religious norms in charitable giving behavior |
| @reinsteinDecomposingDesertTangibility2011 | @rienerReplicationDataReinstein2022 | Experimental data decomposing desert and tangibility effects in charitable giving |

## Data Management and Sharing Policy

I am committed to open science practices and transparent research. All
data from my published research is made available through appropriate
repositories after a reasonable embargo period. Research data is
archived according to the FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible,
Interoperable, and Reusable). I am currently working on making older
data available.

For inquiries about accessing data from ongoing projects or unpublished
research, please contact me at
[g.riener\@soton.ac.uk](mailto:g.riener@soton.ac.uk).
